about: Captured from jellyfin/jellyfin:12.4 (jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3) by test/fixtures/dovi and test/fixtures/e2e.sh's hdr_film films (media/hdr), each 640x360, 24 fps, 20 s, HEVC Main 10 (AV1 for Dolby Ten), AAC, in MP4. Ids, tokens and play session ids are left out. 'video' is the video stream of the item DTO (identical in PlaybackInfo's MediaSources[].MediaStreams). 'playbackInfo' is the decision for each of deviceProfiles, built from the Chrome profile of transcode-12.4.json: hevc (and av1) added to the MP4 and Matroska direct play and to the fMP4 HLS transcoding profile, the hevc CodecProfile's VideoProfile 'main|main 10' and VideoLevel 123 as jellyfin-web writes them for a browser that plays HEVC Main 10, and VideoRangeType per profile: sdr = SDR; hdr10 = SDR|HDR10|HDR10Plus|HLG; hdr10only = SDR|HDR10; dv = SDR|HDR10|HDR10Plus|HLG|DOVI|DOVIWithHDR10|DOVIWithHLG|DOVIWithSDR|DOVIWithHDR10Plus; dvfull = SDR|HDR10|HDR10Plus|HLG|DOVI|DOVIWithHDR10|DOVIWithHLG|DOVIWithSDR|DOVIWithHDR10Plus|DOVIWithEL|DOVIWithELHDR10Plus|DOVIInvalid. masterVariants are the STREAM-INF lines of the master playlist the TranscodingUrl names, in order (BANDWIDTH, RESOLUTION and FRAME-RATE left out); a first variant whose CODECS is not avc1 is a copy of the file video.
